findings.claim: Fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) revenue was approximately $7.7M, up 9.2% year over year from $7.1M; operating income was $1.5M (19.9% margin) and diluted EPS was $0.12 vs $0.11.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus Group Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: Core Marine Technology revenue fell 15.2% year over year to $3.4M (hardware revenue down 17.8% to $2.3M), which management attributed to reduced procurement activity in the Middle East and Asia amid the conflict involving Iran.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus Group Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: Defense Engineering Services revenue rose 68.3% year over year to $2.7M on higher activity and funding across long-standing defense programs; sustainment spares orders exceeded $2.4M year to date.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus (CODA) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript | The Motley Fool

findings.claim: Since the prior call, Coda received approximately $1.4M of U.S. Navy orders for DAVD tethered systems and peripherals, including four DAVD Flex systems and Echoscope sonars for training use.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus (CODA) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript | The Motley Fool

findings.claim: The U.S. Navy completed its Authorization for Navy Use (ANU) assessment of the DAVD untethered system with Gen 4 HUD; 24 untethered systems have been delivered to the Navy in total, including 16 earlier in 2026.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus (CODA) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript | The Motley Fool

findings.claim: The U.S. defense engineering unit is supporting several prime contractors in developing rugged deployable RF electronic warfare systems for unmanned systems, helicopters, airborne pods and ground vehicles; the Nano compact 3D sonar is being integrated with subsea robotic OEMs.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus (CODA) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript | The Motley Fool

findings.claim: Consolidated gross margin declined to 65.4% from 68.3% a year earlier due to revenue mix, geography and product mix; Acoustic Sensors and Defense Engineering segment margins also declined.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus Group Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: Cash was $31.7M at July 31, 2026, up $3.0M from October 31, 2025, and the company remains debt free.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus Group Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

findings.claim: Diluted weighted average shares were 11,298,951 for the quarter vs 11,304,549 a year earlier, indicating no material share dilution over the past year.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus Group Form 10-Q for quarter ended July 31, 2026

findings.claim: Quarterly revenue of $7.72M topped the consensus estimate of $7.35M, and EPS of $0.12 was in line with the estimate.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus earnings matched, revenue topped estimates | Investing.com

findings.claim: In 2026, insider activity consisted of sales: a 10% owner (John Steven Emerson) sold 86,254 shares at about $14.95 on March 11, 2026, and the interim CFO sold 2,256 shares on March 19, 2026. No 2026 open-market purchases appeared in the listing.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus Group Inc. (CODA) - Insider Trading Form 4 Filings

findings.claim: A new CFO, Mark Kelly, joined the company and presented on the Q3 FY2026 call, after a period with an interim CFO.
findings.source_title: Coda Octopus (CODA) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript | The Motley Fool

findings.claim: Growth is increasingly driven by lower-margin defense services rather than the high-margin proprietary Marine Technology products, which could weigh on consolidated margins if the Middle East and Asia slowdown persists.
